name: FinParty
description: Watch parties that survive Tailscale, WireGuard and other high-latency links, with a phone remote any family member can use. Retunes SyncPlay's LAN-sized timing tolerances from measured round-trip time and jitter, stops one stalled device freezing everyone, and assembles groups server-side so unmodified native clients just join.
overview: SyncPlay that works over a VPN, plus a one-tap party remote.
